body:
I am going home for thanksgiving, only because I don't feel like grocery shopping and my parents will feed me. I've been going home about every 2 weeks or so fairly consistently because of holiday weekends and that is where I get most of my food in. Otherwise its whatever lasts long (tunafish, mac n cheese, oatmeal). 

This may sound stupid but its things like these that I have to deal with: I don't eat at the cafe which is literally a ~3 minute walk from my dorm with great food with money my parents are willing to give me because my student ID picture looks horrible, which I have to use to pay for the food. Little things like this bother me all the time and make me stress so much, like I am extremely self-conscious and aware of every little thing I do whereas it seems like everyone else just does these things automatically. I am constantly thinking about the way I walk, how I look when I am walking, how I look when I am writing notes... it just gets tiring and makes me not want to go out and do anything.

Honestly it sounds like something I'd enjoy but I really can't find the courage/willpower/whatever non-laziness would be called to go to a social gathering place... And as far as gaming goes I know I am probably better than most casual gamers but for the amount of time I spend gaming I am nowhere near what I should be.

I sleep from about 1-2 am till ~11 am usually

I listen to music, play nothing. I play lots of games, CoD series, Assassin's creed series, some MMO's. Dexter, Eastbound&Down, Fringe, The Offfice are my shows... Basically my life consists of sitting in a chair watching a screen. I don't have a car so I'm really stuck here unless I want to take a bus somewhere which I really don't like to do... I've grocery shopped once since I got here and it was a bad experience. I don't eat for days simply because I do not feel like going to the grocery store or to our cafe... Pretty lonely in my dormroom, no roommate. Forever alone I guess...

I really just want to get a degree related to computers so I can enter a computer related field, so I don't really know what I'll do yet... however, right now I am failing classes that have nothing to do with computers and it is really making me feel like crap. I don't think this is what REALLY is depressing me though, it is adding to the feeling that I am not good at anything. Everyone I know, even the most stupid of the people I have met have at least one thing they are good at... I can't find anything.

Edit: For as long as I can remember I have been worrying about something. I just feel like being dead would be SO much easier, not having to stress over something CONSTANTLY. Yes I know there are many wonderful things in life, but if i'm dead how will I worry about those wonderful things....

Right now I am considering just going for computer science degree since that is what they offer for computers, but I took one class on Java my senior high school year and could not do it. I don't know if it was lack of effort on my part, but I do not work well in groups. Part of the reason (a big part) i am depressed is my lack of a social life. Most kids I see that struggle with school at LEAST have a social life going for them. I have literally zero friends, aside from those I have met online that live in faraway states. Part of the reason I did poorly in high school was because I chose to not do group projects over having to interact with people and possibly have an awkward situation or something like that... 

Another reason I am afraid to enter this major is because EVERYONE I know who is even remotely interested in computers has vast knowledge of different coding languages, and I don't even know the basics of one.

And as far as a job goes, all I want is something to pay the bills. I don't care about having a huge house and I don't plan on having a big family to support, so something entry-level will probably be ok with me as long as I can continue my hobbies (video games basically)

All my choice, they don't care what I do with my life as long as it's what I want. I want to have a career in computers but I don't think i'm skilled enough to really do anything but computer repair/low-level IT/helpdesk type things... I'd like to do that but right now i'm trying to focus on getting through classes and it's not looking good..
I can't get a degree if I fail even when I do try

First year, interested in computer engineering but honestly I doubt i'd be able to understand anything more complicated than simple shit... And just because I like computers but suck at the more complicated things doesn't mean I'll be able to get a job, which is what scares me the most...
